describes: Way P for a whole house (paint.py): what the corner's p3 (blender/parts/finish/finish.json `painted`, used as it is) needs to grow to every wall and opening. `wear` grades the corner's failed paint by the facts; the rest places what the corner had no fact for. Sizes in metres, values in L*.

wear.describes: An opening's severity is scale x wear x its wall's exposure x its sill's tilt factor; a wall's own marks (its trims' tops) take it without the tilt. Wear is (years since the last coat + years neglected) / the upkeep cycle (packs/stavanger-1989/house/paints.json upkeep: the last coat is the cycle's last turn before the house was let go, counted from its building, or a lean-to's; the neglected years count twice, as nothing is touched up). Exposure is from paints.json weather (1 facing the wet winds, `least` on the lee). The tilt factor is 1 + tiltGain x min(1, |tilt| / tiltFull): a sill that falls sends more water to its lower end. `scale` is the one calibration: 107's street front at 1989 is 1, so it is p3 (last coat 1977.6, let go 1986, cycle 13.6 years at wealth 200: wear 1.059; exposure 0.882). Each kind of mark runs only from its threshold in `from` (the narrow runs first, then the tongue, then the peel at the casing's foot and on the tops), its strengths, peel heights and run lengths times the severity, at most `most`. A sill falling less than `level` a metre is level, and leaks at its end toward the weather.

gutter.describes: A leaking gutter joint (house.json features.drips, 'gutter'): its water runs back under the soffit to the wall and down from the eave in one run, as a sill's horn's (finish.json painted.tongue.runoff), its strength times the drip's flow.

shoe.describes: The downpipe's shoe ('shoe' drip) throws its water back on the drip board and the lowest boards: a soft wash, `L` times its flow at the shoe, `width` either side, gone `top` above the wall's foot.

splash.describes: The foot's wetting where no drip names it: a gable takes its verge's run-off (finish.json marks.splash.gable); the lean-to's low eave has no gutter and drips its whole length (`leanEave`).

joint.describes: A butt joint's thin dark on the boards (features.joints), as the junctions': `L` at the joint, gone `mm` either side.

materials.describes: Materials the corner has none of, in finish.json painted.materials' fields: the roof's course planes are its tiles (`roof` names the material they take); the lean-to's cast plinth, its felt and the chimney's render are guessed values in grey, not yet judged.

colour.describes: Way Pc's hue and chroma [C, h] for the materials above, as finish.json painted.colour.mats; the walls' and trims' paint is the pack's (paints.json: a 'repainted' event's, else the era's default), its L* the clay's.
